pr_title: fix: Correct hash and fmt for struct expr
pr_body:
`AExpr` containing `StructFunction::FieldByName` with different `field` names were calculated to have the same `hash` value, resulting in incorrect reuse by `cse`.

This fixes #11116.

issue_context.title: Repeated struct field get gives incorrect output in lazyframe
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
df = pl.DataFrame([{
    "s":{"a": 1,'b':4},
    "c":3
    }]).lazy()
df.with_columns(
    pl.col("s").struct.field("a").alias("s_a"),
    pl.col("s").struct.field("b").alias("s_b"),
    ((pl.col("s").struct.field("a") <= pl.col("c")) & (pl.col("s").struct.field("b") > pl.col("c"))).alias("c_between_a_and_b")
).collect()
```
Output:
```
shape: (1, 5)
┌───────────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬───────────────────┐
│ s         ┆ c   ┆ s_a ┆ s_b ┆ c_between_a_and_b │
│ ---       ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ ---               │
│ struct[2] ┆ i64 ┆ i64 ┆ i64 ┆ bool              │
╞═══════════╪═════╪═════╪═════╪═══════════════════╡
│ {1,4}     ┆ 3   ┆ 1   ┆ 1   ┆ false             │
└───────────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴───────────────────┘
```


### Log output

```shell
No output
```


### Issue description

In this example, both the value of sb and the Boolean expression have incorrect outputs. Turning off common subexpression elimination gives the correct answer. Likewise, commenting out any of the added columns makes the remaining columns correct

### Expected behavior

```python
df = pl.DataFrame([{
    "s":{"a": 1,'b':4},
    "c":3
    }]).lazy()
df.with_columns(
    pl.col("s").struct.field("a").alias("s_a"),
    pl.col("s").struct.field("b").alias("s_b"),
    ((pl.col("s").struct.field("a") <= pl.col("c")) & (pl.col("s").struct.field("b") > pl.col("c"))).alias("c_between_a_and_b")
).collect(comm_subexpr_elim=False)
```
Output:
```

shape: (1, 5)
┌───────────┬─────┬─────┬─────┬───────────────────┐
│ s         ┆ c   ┆ s_a ┆ s_b ┆ c_between_a_and_b │
│ ---       ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ --- ┆ ---               │
│ struct[2] ┆ i64 ┆ i64 ┆ i64 ┆ bool              │
╞═══════════╪═════╪═════╪═════╪═══════════════════╡
│ {1,4}     ┆ 3   ┆ 1   ┆ 4   ┆ true              │
└───────────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴───────────────────┘

```
